description: This PHP source file defines the class ConvertOctal, which provides methods to convert octal numbers to binary, decimal, and hexadecimal representations, with support for array inputs and error handling. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation engine, specifically within the Engineering functions.

classes.name: ConvertOctal
classes.description: A class providing conversion methods from octal to binary, decimal, and hexadecimal, with validation and array handling support.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts an octal number to its binary representation, supporting array inputs and handling negative numbers using two's-complement notation.

methods.name: toDecimal
methods.description: Converts an octal number to its decimal representation, including handling of negative two's-complement numbers.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts an octal number to its hexadecimal representation, with optional padding and validation.
